documentNotes.title: Instructions
documentNotes.statement:
This test has **40 questions**. Look at every page and read the questions carefully.

You have **60 minutes (native English) / 70 minutes (non-native English) to complete the test**. If you finish early wait silently until time is over. There will be a short evaluation afterwards.

Each question is multiple-choice. Choose A, B, C, or **D. Only one answer is correct.**

Some questions contain a short video clip or audio fragment. These are indicated by this icon: 

![Native icon indicating video or audio resource.](https://pub-43290baaaff14857b5dd59610ea438c7.r2.dev/problems/igeo-2018-mmt-question/common-video-icon-v2.png)

. **Click inside the video frame** to start it.

![Native video player control shown in the common instructions.](https://pub-43290baaaff14857b5dd59610ea438c7.r2.dev/problems/igeo-2018-mmt-question/common-video-control-v2.png)

If there is **sound** involved in the question, it is indicated by this icon: 

![Native sound indicator and headset test-file speaker icon.](https://pub-43290baaaff14857b5dd59610ea438c7.r2.dev/problems/igeo-2018-mmt-question/common-sound-icons.png)

. Please check if your headset is working properly with this test file: [test-file speaker icon shown above].

Mark your choice on the **answer sheet** by making a circle around the letter that you want to select. If you make a mistake cross the selected letter and circle a new choice. If you believe there will be any confusion, also write the letter of your answer next to the question number.

For navigation it is best to use the arrows on the keyboard to move the te next (↓ →) of previous (↑ ←) page. **DO NOT CLICK ON THE ESCAPE BUTTON, AS THAT ENDS THE PRESENTATION.**
